rebuttal_or_critique: While I note the arguments for a neutral stance, I remain unconvinced that the time is ripe for such a shift. With core inflation at 5.02% still significantly above our 4% target and a positive output gap of 0.50%, the economy continues to exhibit signs of demand-side pressure. The liquidity surplus of 75,000 crore further necessitates that we maintain our current stance to ensure effective monetary transmission and prevent any premature easing of financial conditions. Our credibility is built on the consistency of our policy response; shifting to neutral now, while core inflation remains sticky, risks unanchoring inflation expectations. I will hold my ground to ensure we achieve a durable convergence of inflation to the target.
